claim.quote: This is the first displaced vertex search result published by HPS.

name: HPS 2016 engineering run: prompt and displaced dark-photon searches

summary.plain: From its 2016 engineering run HPS reports both a prompt-resonance search (39-179 MeV) and its first search for dark photons that decay a short distance from the target; neither saw a signal, and the second lacked enough data to set limits.
summary.technical: 2016 Engineering Run, 10608 nb^-1: prompt resonance search between 39 and 179 MeV with no evidence of dark photons above the QED background (eps^2 >= 10^-5 limit); displaced-vertex search between 60 and 150 MeV with no excess but insufficient luminosity to limit canonical heavy-photon production; first displaced-vertex search published by HPS.

title: Searching for Prompt and Long-Lived Dark Photons in Electro-Produced e+e- Pairs with the Heavy Photon Search Experiment at JLab
why_it_matters: Establishes the displaced-vertex technique before the 2019 and 2021 high-luminosity runs.
